title: Lower ME: Back Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 3 @ RPE 8, fast up → Hurdle Hops 5 → Trap Bar Jump 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Concentric wk 1: normal lowering, then drive up as FAST as possible · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: Concentric phase: no tempo. Control the way down, then move the bar as fast as you can.
